bodySections.heading: Why Research Skills Is Essential in Consulting
bodySections.content: Employers look for verified proficiency in Research Skills to ensure team productivity, project accuracy, and modern technical capability. Candidates with demonstrated Research Skills expertise consistently outperform those with only theoretical knowledge.
bulletPoints: Research Skills is listed as a required skill in over 60% of consulting job postings.
Employers prioritise candidates with verifiable skills over self-declared expertise.

Use TalentXcel Skills Assessment to verify and showcase your proficiency.

bodySections.heading: How to Learn and Demonstrate Research Skills
bodySections.content: The most effective way to build Research Skills proficiency is through a combination of structured learning, hands-on project work, and verified assessment. Showcasing your skill through a verified credential on TalentXcel significantly improves recruiter visibility.
bulletPoints: Start with structured online courses covering Research Skills fundamentals.
Build 2–3 real portfolio projects that demonstrate practical application.
Complete the TalentXcel Skills Assessment to earn a verified credential.
List the credential on your Career Passport and resume.
